title: Why Was Franklin's Kite Experiment So Dangerous?
description:
Benjamin Franklin's kite was never struck by lightning — if a bolt had hit the wet twine, he would almost certainly have died. In June 1752 he stood inside a shed holding a dry silk ribbon while an iron key drew a small spark from a storm cloud.
